title: Telegram forwarding repeats "session not found" forever for a stale armed session id
outcome: A Telegram-armed session id that definitively no longer exists is disarmed after its first not-found failure, so the forwarding loop stops logging the same failure on every poll and across restarts. Transient errors keep the session armed.
acceptance: The stale armed id behind the repeated `telegram> failed to forward assistant message: session not found` line is confirmed from the persisted bot state and logs (read-only; never opening the TermAl host store), and the code path is identified (src/telegram_forwarding.rs forwarding loop around lines 185-199, per Fable2's lead).

On a definitive session-not-found result the forwarding loop disarms that id and persists the disarm; transient errors (e.g. load failures, timeouts) keep it armed. A behavioural test drives a persisted armed list containing a deleted session id through two polls and observes one failure followed by disarm and no repeat, plus a transient-error case that stays armed.
Clean review pair and landing under the standing rule.
